facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; foreign payments must go into a Foreign Exchange Account (FEA) at a bank.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks offer FEA and FCA accounts, and you can withdraw FX cash.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Paystack Starter takes unregistered sellers up to GHS 30,000 lifetime.
facts.L1_registration: A sole proprietorship costs GHS 130 at ORC, plus GHS 70 yearly renewal.
facts.L2_tax_id: Your Ghana Card PIN is your tax ID.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 0–35%; small traders can pay a flat 3% of turnover.
facts.L4_vat_gst: VAT effectively 20%; service providers must register within 30 days, with no threshold.
facts.L5_data_protection: Data Protection Act 2012: register with the Data Protection Commission before processing data.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can cancel within 14 days of goods, or 7 days for services.
facts.L7_incentives: Flat 3% turnover tax for small sellers, and the first GHS 7,056 tax-free.
facts.D1_id_document: Ghana Card, the only ID banks accept.

watch_out.text: Every service provider must register for VAT within 30 days, even small ones.
Qualified professionals can't use the flat 3% scheme.
You can't legally process customer data until you register with the Commission.
